signatureEngine.name: 鳞齿寻踪
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 仿生毒素
refinements.description: 暴击率提升25%；装备者单次消耗的能量达到20点时，每消耗20点能量，获得3秒增益效果：造成电属性伤害时无视目标28%防御力；重复获得时，延长持续时间，至多延长至30秒；进入接战状态时，获得10秒该增益；装备者为非当前操作中角色时，持续时间不再减少。
refinements.descriptionEn: CRIT Rate increases by 25%. When the equipper consumes at least 20 Energy in a single instance, every 20 Energy consumed grants 3s of a buff: when dealing Electric DMG, ignore 28% of the target's DEF. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a maximum of 30s. When entering combat, gain 10s of this buff. While the equipper is not the active character, the duration no longer decreases.

refinements.name: 仿生毒素
refinements.description: 暴击率提升28.8%；装备者单次消耗的能量达到20点时，每消耗20点能量，获得3秒增益效果：造成电属性伤害时无视目标31.5%防御力；重复获得时，延长持续时间，至多延长至30秒；进入接战状态时，获得10秒该增益；装备者为非当前操作中角色时，持续时间不再减少。

basic.name: 普通攻击：吐信
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成电属性伤害；
第四段攻击命中敌人后，获得2点[毒素]，命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，额外获得1点[毒素]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to four attacks forward, dealing Electric DMG.
When the 4th hit lands, gain 2 points of Venom. Hitting a Stunned enemy grants an additional 1 point of Venom.

special.name: 特殊技：獠齿
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动远距离蛇咬， 造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a long-range snake bite forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：毒牙
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动多段远距离蛇咬，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动时，回复5点能量；
长按发动时，会额外消耗能量，每20点发动一次额外的打击，造成电属性伤害，至多额外消耗60点能量；
招式发动后，自身获得3点[毒素]，长按时每额外消耗20点能量，获得1点[毒素]；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第四段[普通攻击：吐信]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash multiple long-range snake bites forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Grants 5 Energy when the move is used.
When activating by holding, consumes additional Energy. For every 20 additional Energy consumed, unleash 1 extra strike that deals Electric DMG, up to a maximum of 60 additional Energy.
After activation, gain 3 Venom. For every additional 20 Energy consumed while holding, gain 1 more Venom.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Tongue Flick.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：反咬一口
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方跃起，落地后进行横扫攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leap forward and perform a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：团伙作案
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方进行多段攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动后，获得3点[毒素]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch multiple attacks ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
After using this skill, gain 3 Venom.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：爬行恐惧
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方发动落雷攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动后，获得3点[毒素]；
招式发动后，开启[以太帷幕：冷血]，持续30秒，期间全队角色暴击伤害提升5%；
重复开启[以太帷幕：冷血]前，将关闭已有的[以太帷幕：冷血]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Deliver a thunderbolt attack in front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
After using this skill, obtain 3 Venom.
After using this skill, activate Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded, lasting 30s. All squad members' CRIT DMG increases by 5% for the duration.
Re-activating Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded a second time will first deactivate the active Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：报警装置
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方跃起，落地后进行横扫攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间，可以快速衔接[特殊技：獠齿]、[强化特殊技：毒牙]和[普通攻击：蛇吻]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Leaps forward and performs a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing Electric DMG.
During this skill, you can quickly chain into Special Attack: Bared Fangs, EX Special Attack: Venomous Bite, and Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：牢饭加餐
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：共犯情谊
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对目标发动连续攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash a series of attacks, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 招式发动时，将触发[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: Upon activating this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.

facts.text: 招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

facts.text: 招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

facts.text: 招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

facts.text:
进入战场时，获得3点[毒素]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次。
拥有[毒素]时，接战状态下每5秒消耗1点[毒素]，触发一次[蚀骨]，造成电属性伤害；
拥有[毒素]时，使全队角色对敌人造成的电属性伤害无视敌人6%防御力，初始能量自动回复大于1.4时，超过部分每超过0.12，额外无视敌人1%防御力，至多无视敌人25%防御力，持续至[毒素]耗尽后30秒。
[蚀骨]额外附加自身335%攻击力的电属性伤害；
队伍中有1/2名电属性角色时，[蚀骨]造成的失衡值提升40%/60%；
获得[毒素]时，每溢出1点[毒素]，触发一次[蚀骨]。
facts.textEn:
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 3 Venom. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While possessing Venom, consume 1 Venom every 5s while in combat to trigger Corrode Bone, dealing Electric DMG.
With Venom, all squad memebrs' Electric DMG ignores 6% of enemy DEF. If initial Energy Regen is higher than 1.4, for every additional 0.12 above that threshold, an additional 1% of the enemy's DEF is ignored, up to a maximum of 25% of enemy DEF. This effect lasts until 30s after Venom is depleted.
Corrode Bone deals additional Electric DMG equal to 335% of ATK.
When there are 1/2 Electric characters in the squad, the Daze dealt by Corrode Bone increases by 40%/60%.
When gaining Venom, every 1 excess point of Venom triggers Corrode Bone once.

cinema.name: 旅人与猎物
cinema.description: 进入战场时，获得的[毒素]点数提升至6点；[核心被动]中无视敌人防御力效果提升至原本的140%，并使全队角色造成的伤害无视目标5%电属性伤害抗性；[蚀骨]造成的伤害无视目标10%电属性伤害抗性。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Venom gained upon entering the battlefield increases to 6. The DEF ignore from the Core Passive increases to 140% of its original value, and all squad members ignore 5% of the target's Electric RES. Corrode Bone DMG ignores 10% of the target's Electric RES.

cinema.name: 饥肠与箴言
cinema.description: [连携技：团伙作案]或[终结技：爬行恐惧]命中处于失衡状态下的敌人后，额外获得3点[毒素]；[普通攻击：蛇吻]造成的伤害提升35%。
cinema.descriptionEn: After a Chain Attack: Gang Operation or Ultimate: Ophidiophobia hits a Stunned enemy, gain an additional 3 Venom. Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss deals 35% increased DMG.

cinema.name: 锁链与暖巢
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 坏蛋的觉悟
cinema.description: 发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]时，获得1层[觉悟]，至多叠加3层；发动[普通攻击：蛇吻]时，消耗全部[觉悟]，每消耗1层额外触发1次不消耗[毒素]的特殊[蚀骨]，该次[蚀骨]无法造成失衡值。
cinema.descriptionEn: When using an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, gain 1 stack of Decidedness, stacking up to 3 times. When using Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss, consume all Decidedness. Each stack consumed triggers 1 special instance of Corrode Bone that does not consume Venom. This Corrode Bone does not cause Daze.

cinema.name: 伪证与獠牙
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 家与六分街道
cinema.description: 每次触发[蚀骨]时，获得1层[蚀骨印记]；全队角色除[蚀骨]外的攻击命中敌人时，消耗1层[蚀骨印记]，触发1次特殊的[蚀骨]，该次[蚀骨]无法造成失衡值，3秒内至多消耗1层[蚀骨印记]。
cinema.descriptionEn: Each time Corrode Bone is triggered, gain 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion. When attacks from any squad member, other than Corrode Bone, hit an enemy, consume 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion to trigger 1 special Corrode Bone. This instance of Corrode Bone cannot inflict Daze, and at most 1 stack of Bone-Deep Corrosion can be consumed every 3s.

basic.name: 普通攻击：吐信
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成电属性伤害；
第四段攻击命中敌人后，获得2点[毒素]，命中处于失衡状态下的敌人时，额外获得1点[毒素]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to four attacks forward, dealing Electric DMG.
When the 4th hit lands, gain 2 points of Venom. Hitting a Stunned enemy grants an additional 1 point of Venom.

basic.name: 普通攻击：蛇吻
basic.description:
拥有[蛇影]时可长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
希希芙跳入空中并锁定目标，随后落地对范围内敌人造成电属性伤害；
锁定期间，保持长按 【普通攻击键】 并拖曳摇杆可以延长锁定时间，并自由控制落地位置；
每获得6点[毒素]，自身获得1层[蛇影]效果，至多获得3层；
进入战场时，获得1层[蛇影]效果；
招式发动时消耗1层[蛇影]；
命中敌人后，快速消耗所有[毒素]并触发[蚀骨]；
招式发动时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
With Serpentine Shadow, hold [Basic Attack] to launch:
Cissia leaps into the air and locks onto a target, then slams down, dealing Electric DMG to enemies in the area.
While locking on, continue to hold [Basic Attack] and drag the joystick to extend the lock-on duration and freely control the landing position.
For every 6 points of Venom gained, gain 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow, stacking up to 3 times.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow.
Using this skill consumes 1 stack of Serpentine Shadow.
Upon hitting an enemy, all Venom is consumed to trigger Corrode Bone.
Upon activating this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basic.name: 蚀骨
basic.description:
对附近敌人造成电属性伤害；
每次触发，使自身暴击率提升6%，持续15秒，至多叠加3层，重复触发刷新持续时间。
basic.descriptionEn:
Deal Electric DMG to nearby enemies.
Each trigger increases CRIT Rate by 6% for 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：齿痕
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前进行快速斩击，造成电属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Dash forward with a swift slash, dealing Electric DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：獠齿
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动远距离蛇咬， 造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a long-range snake bite forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：毒牙
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动多段远距离蛇咬，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动时，回复5点能量；
长按发动时，会额外消耗能量，每20点发动一次额外的打击，造成电属性伤害，至多额外消耗60点能量；
招式发动后，自身获得3点[毒素]，长按时每额外消耗20点能量，获得1点[毒素]；
招式发动后，可直接衔接第四段[普通攻击：吐信]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Unleash multiple long-range snake bites forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Grants 5 Energy when the move is used.
When activating by holding, consumes additional Energy. For every 20 additional Energy consumed, unleash 1 extra strike that deals Electric DMG, up to a maximum of 60 additional Energy.
After activation, gain 3 Venom. For every additional 20 Energy consumed while holding, gain 1 more Venom.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Tongue Flick.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：爬行恐惧
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方发动落雷攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动后，获得3点[毒素]；
招式发动后，开启[以太帷幕：冷血]，持续30秒，期间全队角色暴击伤害提升5%；
重复开启[以太帷幕：冷血]前，将关闭已有的[以太帷幕：冷血]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Deliver a thunderbolt attack in front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
After using this skill, obtain 3 Venom.
After using this skill, activate Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded, lasting 30s. All squad members' CRIT DMG increases by 5% for the duration.
Re-activating Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded a second time will first deactivate the active Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：报警装置
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方跃起，落地后进行横扫攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间，可以快速衔接[特殊技：獠齿]、[强化特殊技：毒牙]和[普通攻击：蛇吻]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Leaps forward and performs a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing Electric DMG.
During this skill, you can quickly chain into Special Attack: Bared Fangs, EX Special Attack: Venomous Bite, and Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
